statement: The supplied source (Wikipedia: Taylor series) defines and works exclusively with the single-variable Taylor series of a function of one real (or complex) variable, expanded in powers of (x - a) using ordinary derivatives at a point. It contains no definition of a Taylor expansion for a function of several variables: no partial derivatives, no gradient/Hessian terms, no multi-index notation, and no statement of how the single-variable formula generalizes to R^n. Because the concept requested here (Multivariate Taylor Expansion) is not present in the supplied sources — only its single-variable special case is — stating the multivariate definition would require introducing content from memory, which is not permitted.
